svg.title: Fast generation
svg.desc: Workload fingerprints line up with the bulk call that moves parsing and bounds work out of the loop.

text.tspan: The input already tells you the fast path.

g.title: A dense box is a bounds problem
g.desc: fill_cuboid grows the bounds once and resolves one block id for the entire volume.

g.title: Sparse equal blocks travel as one batch
g.desc: set_blocks crosses the binding once with an array of positions and one parsed descriptor.

g.title: Resolve mixed ids before the hot loop
g.desc: prepare turns block states into palette indices once; place writes those indices in the loop.

g.title: Geometry pays for shape and material
g.desc: BuildingTool.fill evaluates the shape and brush per selected cell because both affect the result.

text.tspan: Match the operation to the shape of the input
Bulk generation is fastest when the API can resolve bounds, descriptors, or palettes outside the per-cell loop.
